name: smart-speed-detection
description: IoT vehicle speed detection: IR gate -> Arduino -> bridge -> server -> real-time dashboard with vision snapshots

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @smart-speed/shared build && concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter @smart-speed/server dev" "pnpm --filter @smart-speed/web dev"
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @smart-speed/shared test && pnpm --filter @smart-speed/server test && pnpm --filter @smart-speed/bridge test && pnpm test:vision && pnpm --filter @smart-speed/web test
scripts.test:vision: cd apps/vision && (test -x .venv/bin/pytest && .venv/bin/pytest || echo "[vision] venv missing — see apps/vision/README (python3.11 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt)")
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @smart-speed/shared typecheck && pnpm --filter @smart-speed/server typecheck && pnpm --filter @smart-speed/bridge typecheck && pnpm --filter @smart-speed/web typecheck
